haikus.haiku:
Moldy rind sings soft
Cheese swirls amber glow in room
Warm crumbs dance bright near
Happy #NationalMoldyCheeseDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Mail bags hum early
Postmen smile as stamps glide near
Letters travel bright
Happy #WorldPostDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft breeze hums through trees
Songs of peace in bright summer
Joy rings in each heart
#HappyBirthdayJohnLennon from @ClamBakeSanta
